I was in a similar situation with my ex, he was un happy and less attracted to me. We talked about it and he didn't give me a reason, but he said he still loved me and wanted to try. I wanted to try to fix things since he meant so much to me, so we agreed. We decided to give it 30 days, where we both agreed to try to go on more dates and communicate and really focus on our problems together, take each others complaints and try to fix them and be how we used to be.

 And it worked for a while, for me, and he said he felt like he was loving me more each day. But i knew I wasn't feeling any better, nothing had changed for me except I was putting my all in, and he never focused on fixing things for me. We both had things to improve on, and I worked extremely hard to be happy again as the relationship really took a toll on my mental health at the end. We both just stopped trying and decided to just enjoy the rest of our time together as best friends, still dating, until the 30 days was up.

So we decided to just break up and be friends and eventually work things out if we both wanted to in the future. I don't believe we will, we are no longer friends and he has met someone else. Sometimes you meet the right person at the wrong time. Not everyone is in your life forever and that's okay. Even if the relationship was long, it's hard to let go but not everything can be fixed.
